qualities: implicated in the failure he describes

policy.note: He did not only warn against humanity's ambition; he participated in the desire to preserve everything. Show implication, not omniscience.

beats.title: Notices beauty and danger
beats.action: He notices the beauty and danger of early industrial change.
beats.staging: Steam and damp timber through a reflection; partial face at frame edge; no captioned judgment.
beats.implication: Beauty draws him closer as danger begins.

beats.title: Mends a stranger's sleeve
beats.action: He helps mend a stranger's sleeve.
beats.staging: Hands and cloth in focus; faces soft or cropped; care as ordinary labour.
beats.implication: He can still choose a small repair over spectacle.

beats.title: Receives help with the coat
beats.action: He receives help when his own coat catches on a nail.
beats.staging: Nail, snagged fabric, stranger's hands; slightly awkward body; not heroic rescue.
beats.implication: He needs others; the archive later forgets this mutuality.

beats.title: Watches a worker ask for help
beats.action: He watches a worker ask for assistance.
beats.staging: Out-of-focus movement of the ask; ancestor's eye-line sharp; he does not become the answer.
beats.implication: Witness is not yet warning; the ask hangs.

beats.title: Follows the melody instead of stopping
beats.action: He follows the melody instead of stopping.
beats.staging: Camera/body drift toward unfinished melody; injured ask falls behind in soft focus.
beats.implication: Desire to follow the music outweighs stopping for need — early implication.

beats.title: Preserves while dinner calls
beats.action: He preserves voices and images while someone calls him to dinner.
beats.staging: See CLIP_ANC_CAMERA_DINNER — ordinary, slightly embarrassing unedited take.
beats.implication: Ordinary life ignored while preservation continues — he is already inside the pattern Oino inherits.

beats.title: Cannot tell which recording is true
beats.action: He becomes unable to tell Oino which recording is true.
beats.staging: Damaged film / reconstructed plates side by side; partial faces; no omniscient answer.
beats.implication: Archive excess breaks certainty; he cannot judge truth for her.

beats.title: Zone exit — no certainty
beats.action: He stands at the Zone exit and offers no certainty.
beats.staging: Silhouette or reflection at threshold; incomplete warning; not a supernatural judge.
beats.implication: Ends as warning without map — loving, fallible, implicated.

unedited_archive_clip.title: Younger ancestor adjusts camera while dinner calls

action.on_screen: Younger ancestor keeps adjusting the camera — framing, focus, fidgeting with the device.
action.off_screen: Someone calls him to dinner (domestic call — not a scare).

unedited_archive_clip.reveals: He did not simply warn against humanity's ambition; he participated in the desire to preserve everything.
